description: Register a domain for certificate issuance and start its DCV (Certificate Manager 2.0). dcvType PTXT = set the DNS TXT record once and reuse it; TXT = a new record per issuance. Public zone only. Works with main-account and Sub Account keys (Sub Account verified 2026-11-25; earlier the 2.0 API rejected Sub Account keys with HTTP 403).

dcvType.description: DCV type: PTXT (persistent TXT) or TXT (per-issuance TXT)

issueType.description: How certificates for this domain are issued: CONSOLE or ACME

name: ncloud_cm2_register_domain
